bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sfrxUSD is native on Ethereum and Fraxtal; 25 other tracked EVM deployments are FraxZero LayerZero OFTs, and Solana, Aptos, and Movement are non-EVM OFT representations with documented direct connectivity to both Fraxtal and Ethereum. Current 2026-08-16 reads confirm the Fraxtal lockbox as the hub peer, the Ethereum lockbox as a canonical-side authorized minter, a common representation ProxyAdmin, and 3-of-6 chain-local OFT owner Safes for the six previously reviewed EVM routes. Frax documents that OFTs burn on the source and mint on the destination through LayerZero, while the lockboxes provide the external-lock route; these representations are not direct Frax balance-sheet liabilities. Endpoint DVN configuration, enforced options, rate limits, and lockbox redemption caps remain unresolved.

protocols.name: FraxZero LayerZero OFT hub
protocols.note: Frax states that non-Ethereum/non-Fraxtal deployments are OFTs, which mint on receipt and burn on send; all OFTs and lockboxes are managed by a 3/6 multisig per chain.

controls.label: Ethereum sfrxUSD lockbox owner Safe

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Frax Comptroller Safe is the current owner of the Ethereum sfrxUSD lockbox, which is the canonical-side bridge escrow and authorized minter observed in the Ethereum sfrxUSD minter set.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The lockbox is a bridge proxy; its common ProxyAdmin 0x223a681fc5c5522c85c96157c0efa18cd6c5405c is recorded separately, while additional lockbox owner, pause, and limit semantics were not independently decoded.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771126 (2026-08-16), the Ethereum sfrxUSD lockbox 0x7311cea93ccf5f4f7b789ee31eba5d9b9290e126 resolved to implementation 0xf07571bedb8cbd98e6ca43b5ee0fb178477d2219 and common ProxyAdmin 0x223a681fc5c5522c85c96157c0efa18cd6c5405c; owner() returned the Frax Comptroller Safe 0xB1748C79709f4Ba2Dd82834B8C82D4a505003f27. This is bridge-route administration and escrow ownership, not an independent native issuer.

controls.label: Ethereum sfrxUSD canonical lockbox

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Ethereum lockbox is an authorized sfrxUSD minter on the canonical Ethereum route and provides the mintable adapter/lockbox path for cross-chain transfer.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The lockbox's Fraxtal peer and endpoint configuration were not independently decoded in this pass.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Lockbox redemption caps, rate limits, and supply-conservation accounting were not independently enumerated.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The current implementation and common ProxyAdmin were read at the fixed observation block; owner and proxy-admin powers remain separate bridge failure domains.

controls.capDescription: The lockbox can mint and burn the canonical-side bridge representation; current numeric redemption and rate-limit bounds were not independently enumerated.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771126, the sfrxUSD lockbox proxy resolved to implementation 0xf07571bedb8cbd98e6ca43b5ee0fb178477d2219 and common ProxyAdmin 0x223a681fc5c5522c85c96157c0efa18cd6c5405c. The live canonical token minter set separately confirmed this lockbox as the second authorized minter; its supply-conserving bridge accounting remains Bridge Risk evidence.

controls.label: Fraxtal sfrxUSD lockbox hub and LayerZero peer

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Frax's official cross-chain address inventory identifies 0x88aa7854d3b2daa5e37e7ce73a1f39669623a361 as the Fraxtal sfrxUSD lockbox hub.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At the reviewed 2026-08-16 reads, every representation's LayerZero peers(30255) returned the Fraxtal lockbox and peers(30101) returned zero; this is the reviewed hub topology rather than six independent native mint paths.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Fraxtal lockbox rate limits, redemption caps, and aggregate supply reconciliation were not independently enumerated.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Fraxtal lockbox's owner, proxy-admin, pause, and upgrade configuration was not independently decoded; no governance or delay is inferred.

controls.capDescription: The Fraxtal lockbox is the hub-side bridge mint/burn and peer path for the six external representations; route conservation depends on lockbox accounting and LayerZero message validation.
controls.evidence: Frax's official cross-chain address page identifies the Fraxtal lockbox as the sfrxUSD hub. At the current representation reads on 2026-08-16, all six OFT peers bound their LayerZero peer ID 30255 to this lockbox and had no peer configured for 30101. The hub and peer facts remain bridge-route machinery, not local native issuance.

controls.label: sfrxUSD LayerZero lockbox and representation ProxyAdmin

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The common ProxyAdmin address 0x223a681fc5c5522c85c96157c0efa18cd6c5405c was observed for the Ethereum lockbox and all six representation proxies; it can replace bridge-route implementations. ProxyAdmin owner, delay, and emergency controls were not independently enumerated.

controls.capDescription: The common ProxyAdmin is a shared bridge upgrade failure domain across the Ethereum lockbox and six representation proxies; it is not a native mint controller.
controls.evidence: At the fixed 2026-08-16 route reads, the Ethereum lockbox and each Sei, Mode, XLayer, Katana, Sonic, and Arbitrum sfrxUSD OFT proxy resolved to common ProxyAdmin 0x223a681fc5c5522c85c96157c0efa18cd6c5405c. This shared bridge upgrade surface remains scoreable under Bridge Risk.
